verdict.rationale: The only evidence pointing toward data portability is an API claimed to give 'full control of your workflow' and a Zapier integration. Together with scanned mail kept in cloud storage, this implies you could pull your data out programmatically. Nothing documents a bulk export, open formats, or an offboarding path, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented bulk data export, named open export formats (e.g. PDF/CSV/JSON), an account-closure or offboarding process, a public API reference, and independent confirmation that export works.
